chapter.verse: Ahih hangin Ananias a kici mi khat in a zi Sapphira tawh kopin neihsa khat zuak hi.
A sumkhotte kimkhat a zi' theihpihna tawh ama' ading khen sim a, a omlai teng bek hong kengin sawltakte' khe-phung ah koih hi.
Ahi zongin Peter in, “Ananias aw, Kha Siangtho a khem dingin leh na leitang khotna sum kimkhat nang' ading a khen sim dingin bang hangin Satan in na lungsim hong dimsak mawk hiam?

Nang' khutsung ahih lai-in nang' a mah hilo ahi hiam? A kizuak ciangin zong na sumkhot teng nang' thu mah hilo ahi hiam? Bang hangin na lungsim sungah hih vai geelkha na hi hiam? Mihing a khem na hikei a, Pasian a khem na hi hi,” ci hi.
Hih thute a zak ciangin Ananias puksukin a hu tawpna sangkhia hi. Hih thu a za khempeuh tungah zahtak launa lianpi tung hi.
Khangnote kithawi-in amah lakhia pah uh a, zawngkhia-in va vui uh hi.
Tua khit, nai thum khawng khat ciangin bang thupiang om cih thei lo pi-in a zi Sapphira hong tum hi.
Peter in, “Leitang na zuakkhiat uh, hizah mah tawh maw cih hong gen in,” ci hi. Sapphira in, “Himah, tua zah tawh himah,” ci hi.
Ahih hangin Peter in, “Bang hangin Topa' Kha zia-et ding kithukim mawk na hi uh hiam? En in, kongkhak gei ah na pasal a va vuite' khe om a, nang hong zawngkhia ding uh hi,” ci hi.
Sapphira zong thakhat thu-in Peter' khe-phung ah puksuk a, a hu tawpna sangkhia hi. Khangnote hong tum uh ciangin tua numei a si-a om mu uh ahih manin zawngkhia uh a, a pasal' gei-ah vui uh hi.
Pawlpi bup leh hih thute a za khempeuh tungah launa lianpi piang hi.
Tu-in sawltakte' khut tungtawnin mite lakah kihilna lim lamdang tampi piang a, amaute a vekun Solomon' Talap ah lungsim kikhatin om uh hi.
A omlaite khat beek in sawltakte pawlpih ngam lo uh ahih hangin mite in nakpi-in thupi sa uh hi.
Tua hi a, Topa' sungah thu-um mi numei pasal a lomlomin kibehlap hi.
Amaute in cinate lampi ah puakhia uh a, Peter a paiphei hun ciangin ama' liim in cinate kimkhat beek a nawkkhak nading cihna tawh luainote leh taalte tungah sial uh hi.
Jerusalem kiima khuate panin zong mite hong kikhawmin cinate leh kha nin vei-a gimna thuakte hong paipih uh a, a vekpi-un damna ngah uh hi.
Tua ciangin siampi lianpenpa leh amah tawh kipawlte (Sadducee pawlke) khempeuh kithawi-in biaknavai thangpaihna tawh kidim uh a,
sawltakte manin tangpi thong ah khum uh hi.
Ahih hangin zan sungin Topa' vanmi khat in thong kongkhakte hongin amaute paikhiatpih a,
“Va pai unla biakinnpi ah dingin mite' kiangah Nuntakna thu a vekin genkhia un,” ci hi.

Hih thu a zak uh ciangin amaute zong khuavak tuungin biakinnpi ah pai uh a, thuhilh kipan uh hi. Tu-in siampi lianpenpa leh amah tawh kipawlte hong pai-in Israel mite' thukhen makai bup ahi Sanhedrin kikhop sam uh a, sawltakte hong paipih dingin thong ah mi sawl uh hi.
Ahih hangin zum nasemte a tun uh ciangin thong sungah sawltakte mu lo uh ahih manin kilehkik uh a,
“Thong kongkhakte bittak kikalhin thongcingte zong kongkhak gei-a a ding ka mu uh hi. Himah taleh ka hon uh ciangin a sungah kuamah ka mu kei uh hi,” ci-in thu zasak uh hi.
Biakinn-cing bupa leh siampi liante in hih thu a zak uh ciangin a bangci thu hiam ci-in hih thu hangin nakpi lungbuai uh hi.
Tua laitak mi khat hong pai-in amaute' kiangah, “En un! Thong sunga na khum uh pasalte biakinnpi ah dingin mite hilhcian uh hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin bupa leh zum nasemte va pai uh a, sawltakte hong paipih uh hi. Mihonpi' den ding lau uh ahih manin zawhthawh thu zang lo uh hi.
Amaute in sawltakte paipihin Sanhedrin mai-ah koih uh hi. Tua ciangin siampi lianpenpa in thudotna nei a,
“Hih min tawh thu hilhcian lo dingin khamna khauhtak hong pia hilo ka hi uh hiam? Hinapi Jerusalem khua ah na hilhcianna uh na kizelsak uh a, hih mipa' sisan ko' tung nong suat sawm uh hi,” ci hi.
Ahih hangin Peter leh sawltakte in hih bangin dawng uh hi: “Mi' thu sangin Pasian' thu ka man ding uh hizaw hi.
Singkhuam tung khai-a na thahlup uh Jesu pen i pu i pate' Pasian in thokiksak a,
tua Pasian mah in amah pen Israel mite' tungah kisikna leh mawhmaina a pia dingin Makai leh Honpa dinmun tawh ama' taklam ah tawisang hi.
Hih thute ah kote teci ka hi uh a, Pasian in ama' thu a mangte' tunga a piak Kha Siangtho zong ahi hi.”
Hih thu a zak uh ciangin amaute heh mahmah uh a, sawltakte that nuam uh hi.
Ahih hangin Gamaliel a kici, mi khempeuh' zahtak thukhun hilhcian sya khat ahi, Sanhedrin sunga kihel Pharisee mi khat dingto a, sawltakte tawmvei sung a pusuahsak nading uh thupia hi.
Tua ciangin makaite' kiangah hih bangin gen hi: “Israel mite aw, hih mite' tungah na hih sawm thu uh kidawm un.
A hang pen tuma lai-in Theudas hong khangin mithupi ka hi a cih ciangin mi tampi, a malin zali bang, in amah beel uh hi. Amah kithatin amah a zuite khempeuh kithehthang uh a, bangmahlo suak uh hi.
Ama' khit, milip simna hun sungin Galilee mi Judas hong khangin mite paikhialhpih hi. Tua mipa zong si-in amah a zuite khempeuh kithehthang uh hi.
Tua hi a, tu-a thu ah zong kong cihin ah hih mite hici koih lel unla amau kia omsak un. A hang pen hih vaihawmna, ahihkeileh hih vaidinna, mihing' geeltawm ahihleh kisia ding a,
Pasian' geel ahihleh amaute na susia zokei ding uh hi. Pasian a langpang peuh na suakzaw kha ding uh hi.” Makaite in Gamaliel' thugen sang thei uh ahih manin
sawltakte samin sat uh a, Jesu' min tawh thu a gen nawnloh ding uh khauhtak a kham khit uh ciangin khah uh hi.
Sawltakte zong Sanhedrin makaite' mai pan paikhia uh a, Jesu' min hangin maizumsakna a thuak dingin Pasian in amaute kilawm a sakna hangin lungdam mahmah uh hi.
Tua ciangin biakinnpi leh inn citeng ah nisim tawlnga lo-in hilhcian uh a, Khris pen Jesu hi cih Lungdamna Thu tangko uh hi.
